name: Cinder
long_description:
From content moderation to AI safety, Cinder empowers businesses to orchestrate and automate digital safety at scale. Cinder was founded to help organizations foster safe online spaces for everyone. Our platform empowers companies from start-ups to enterprises with end-to-end capabilities to mitigate harm, investigate abuse, and produce trustworthy and reliable AI outcomes. Building your world-class company means keeping your users and community safe—Cinder unlocks faster growth by making safety easy. We work with customers in every industry from frontier AI labs to e-commerce and social media. 

We're hiring across a variety of teams and looking for candidates based in NYC or open to relocating to NYC, and able to work in-person.
one_liner: Infrastructure to protect companies from AI abuse

name: SafetyKit
long_description:
SafetyKit's AI agents do the dirty work for big tech and finance companies so humans don't have to.

Today companies rely on armies of low-paid outsourced humans to protect their platforms from fraud, harassment, and crime. It’s super important work, but the jobs are difficult and sometimes traumatizing, and it’s impossible to keep up. Our mission is to end this manual toil.

We learned this domain first-hand at Stripe and Airbnb, where first we built software for human reviewers, and then built models to replace them.

We’re a group of engineers from Stripe, Meta, Netflix, MIT, and Princeton that love language models and unironically love B2B SaaS. We know the economy is going to be rearranged over the next 4 years and we want to be in the driver’s seat.

We build vertical AI that works and have some of the world’s largest companies as paying customers. Patreon, Eventbrite, Upwork, Character.ai, Substack, Faire, along with a $10B+ marketplace, a $100B+ payments company, and more rely on SafetyKit in production.
one_liner: AI agents for risk, compliance, and safety

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: David led engineering for risk reviews at Stripe for fraud, credit, content moderation, and financial crimes. He built the policy and workflow engine that scaled Stripe from internal reviewers to thousands of outsourced vendor agents.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Steven is a cofounder of SafetyKit, working to replace human risk reviewers with language models.

Previously he worked at Carbic as the first software engineer and later as the CEO. There he helped build ultrasonic flow sensors which were installed on oil pipelines and offshore rigs around the world.

Steven also cofounded Thomas Street, a software design and engineering consultancy, where he worked with companies like Cisco, Roche, and DirecTV.

name: Inth
long_description:
Inth monitors your pull requests, codebase and website to catch privacy issues and turns them into fixes and evidence.

Every product change you make exposes you to privacy risk. Customers lose trust. Fines and lawsuits are given. Fundraising and customer deals are broken. New market launches halt.

The growth you thought you would have slows because privacy compliance is overwhelming and changes with every product update.

Inth is fixing this to help you automate privacy compliance to ship and grow faster.

Inth scans your PRs, website and codebase to catch any privacy risk. It then fixes and evidences them against your product, policies and global privacy laws to automate privacy compliance in every region your customers are in.

Start a free privacy scan at: inth.com
one_liner: Monitor and fix product privacy issues before they block growth

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Founder of Inth, the AI-native privacy company helping teams ship and grow faster by automating privacy compliance across pull requests, codebases, and websites.

Previously founded Everfund. Creator of c15t, open-source consent and privacy infrastructure with 3M+ npm downloads, and CookieBench. Spent the last decade building developer tools, privacy systems, and trust infrastructure.

launches.title: Inth: Dev-first cookie banners that don't slow your site
launches.tagline: Built for performance and full developer control.
launches.body:
tldr: your cookie banner is slowing down your site. Inth banners keep performance high, styled using your own components, and keeps you compliant using our open-source core, [c15t.com](http://c15t.com).

Inth is building cookie banners that don't cost your Core Web Vitals.

For years, cookie banners have plagued the internet with slow bloated scripts, that aren't aware of user locations or local laws, built for marketing and legal teams. Inth is fixing this with developer-first consent infrastructure.

<https://youtu.be/RJ7cSk1QYi8>

Inth helps developers automate cookie consent and user data rights to ensure compliance with all jurisdictions, using the fastest and most composable cookie banner available, c15t.

Bundled into your website's code, c15t cookie banners have native SDKs, i18n, and are fully customizable to match your UI and brand. Built for developers who care about compliance and performance.

Since Inth launched, c15t has grown over 2 million npm downloads, and is used by some of the top developer tools companies, luxury hotel chains, and online supermarkets.

Join the teams already using Inth to deploy faster, compliant websites at [inth.com](http://inth.com) or quickstart: npx @c15t/cli

Find our docs here: c15t.com/docs
